reflections: Dane is coordinating the repair drive and relies on discreet, low-key help from others.
Uli is willing to help but is cautious about keeping involvement quiet.
Cleo is practical and support-oriented, focused on inventory and identifying missing supplies.
Dane relies on others to cover coordination while he stays quiet and catches up behind the scenes.
Cleo is handling practical inventory work and waiting for a clear supply check before moving forward.
Vik is the main communications helper, keeping the group informed while keeping the effort low-key.
Vik is the main organizer and repeatedly takes responsibility for reminders, updates, and keeping things simple for the group.
Dane is trying to stay helpful but is slightly behind; he keeps deferring until Cleo finishes checking supplies and then offers to fill gaps quietly.
Cleo and Hana are handling the concrete coordination first, with others waiting on Cleo's supply check before confirming the remaining needs.
Dane tends to be apologetic and deferential, often waiting on others to finish before helping and trying to keep things low-key.
Cleo appears to be a coordinating dependency for the group, with others waiting on Cleo’s updates before moving forward.
Quinn, Eli, and Sam respond supportively and keep tasks simple, practical, and collaborative.
Dane is coordinating quietly and relying on others to handle specific tasks when he is behind.
Sam, Uli, and Opal are cooperative and responsive, each taking on clear support roles without much friction.
The group communication is low-key and task-focused, with an emphasis on staying organized and keeping Sunday’s community-center plan on track.
